mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.summary, p.cover, p.category_id, p.author_id, p.status, p.pinned, p.recommended, p.views, p.likes, p.publish_time, p.create_time, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM post_favorite f JOIN post p ON p.id = f.post_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_favorite f JOIN post p ON p.id = f.post_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
